title: Impersonal Si: si dice, si fa

blocks.markdown: **Si** + a verb in the third person expresses a general, impersonal statement — like English "one says", "people say", "you do" (generic "you"). *Si dice che...* (People say that...). *In Italia si mangia bene* (In Italy, people eat well / the food is good). If the following noun is plural, the verb becomes plural too: *Si vendono i biglietti qui* (Tickets are sold here).

exercises.prompt: In Italia ___ mangia molto bene. (impersonal si)
Come ___ dice "thank you" in italiano? (impersonal — How does one say ...?)
Translate: "Tickets are sold here." (impersonal si, plural agreement)
